status: New validation prompted by the realization that allocation across a multi-week evaluation window is not operationally feasible. Protocol frozen before inspecting daily-batch results.
primary_question: Does the same-workload reallocation result survive when query capacity can be shared only among routes dispatched in the same country, calendar week, and weekday?
fixed_operational_policy: At least one query per route, then allocate remaining capacity within the daily country batch by predicted DG divided by route size; maximum 10 queries per route.
matched_capacity: For every daily country batch, use exactly the total attempts generated by top-b-per-route.
past_only_selection: Reuse each prior uniform-route budget chosen on the last two calibration weeks, then choose a cap from 5, 7, 10, 15, or unlimited on the same calibration-only tuning period. Also report a joint calibration-only budget-cap choice over budgets 1, 2, 3, 5, and 10.
limits: Week ID plus weekday is the finest date key in the public data; simultaneous dispatch within that batch is assumed. Software plan stages remain proxy answers.
